attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Wisconsin state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "WI" streq } over if
apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "WI" streq } over if

action_details.action_dsl: add "Wisconsin filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state)." to job.audit_trail; add "Reference: Wisconsin Form 4 (Corporation Franchise or Income Tax Return)" to job.audit_trail; add "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.22 (Corporations, general provisions)" to job.audit_trail; add "Reference: WI Department of Revenue Publication 112" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "Wisconsin filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state)." job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Form 4 (Corporation Franchise or Income Tax Return)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.22 (Corporations, general provisions)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Department of Revenue Publication 112" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_dsl: add "Wisconsin filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair)." to job.audit_trail; add "Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions." to job.audit_trail; add "Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018)" to job.audit_trail; add "Reference: Wisconsin Tax Bulletin 203 (July 2018) - Economic Nexus Guidance" to job.audit_trail; add "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.22(1r) (Definitions - doing business)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: "Wisconsin filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair)." job.audit_trail swap addto "Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions." job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Tax Bulletin 203 (July 2018) - Economic Nexus Guidance" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.22(1r) (Definitions - doing business)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No Wisconsin nexus - no filing requirement." to job.audit_trail; add "Any estimated payments would be refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Wisconsin nexus - no filing requirement." job.audit_trail swap addto "Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Wisconsin state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Wisconsin state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "Wisconsin state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income." to job.audit_trail; add "Common Wisconsin additions:" to job.audit_trail; add "- Interest on U.S. government obligations (tax-exempt federally but taxable to Wisconsin)" to job.audit_trail; add "- IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback" to job.audit_trail; add "- Federal bonus depreciation addback (Wisconsin partial conformity)" to job.audit_trail; add "- State NOL if deducted on federal return" to job.audit_trail; add "Common Wisconsin subtractions:" to job.audit_trail; add "- Municipal bond interest from other states" to job.audit_trail; add "- Wisconsin net operating loss deduction" to job.audit_trail; add "- Capital gains from qualified Wisconsin small business stock" to job.audit_trail; add "Reference: Wisconsin Form 4 Schedule RT (Apportionment and Allocation)" to job.audit_trail; add "Reference: Wisconsin Form 4I Instructions (Income and Franchise Tax)" to job.audit_trail; add "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.26 (Surtax on tax-option corporations)" to job.audit_trail; add "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.05 (Income - additions and subtractions)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "Wisconsin state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income." job.audit_trail swap addto "Common Wisconsin additions:" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Interest on U.S. government obligations (tax-exempt federally but taxable to Wisconsin)" job.audit_trail swap addto "- IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Federal bonus depreciation addback (Wisconsin partial conformity)" job.audit_trail swap addto "- State NOL if deducted on federal return" job.audit_trail swap addto "Common Wisconsin subtractions:" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Municipal bond interest from other states" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Wisconsin net operating loss deduction" job.audit_trail swap addto "- Capital gains from qualified Wisconsin small business stock" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Form 4 Schedule RT (Apportionment and Allocation)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: Wisconsin Form 4I Instructions (Income and Franchise Tax)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.26 (Surtax on tax-option corporations)" job.audit_trail swap addto "Reference: WI Stat. § 71.05 (Income - additions and subtractions)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no state adjustments calculated
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; add "No nexus - no state adjustments calculated." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No nexus - no state adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Wisconsin state corporate income tax. Applies Wisconsin 7.9% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Wisconsin tax with 7.9% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate; set apportionment.state_tax = the maximum of (apportionment.state_tax - apportionment.state_credits) and (0.0); set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax; add "Wisconsin corporate income tax at 7.9% flat rate. Reference: WI Stat. 71.27" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax apportionment.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "Wisconsin corporate income tax at 7.9% flat rate. Reference: WI Stat. 71.27" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No Wisconsin nexus - no tax liability
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No Wisconsin nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Wisconsin nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No Wisconsin taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No Wisconsin taxable income - no tax liability. Wisconsin NOL rules may apply. Reference: WI Stat. 71.26(4)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Wisconsin taxable income - no tax liability. Wisconsin NOL rules may apply. Reference: WI Stat. 71.26(4)" job.audit_trail swap addto
